stem.en: A field holds a thousand cuttings from one rose bush. A disease arrives that this variety cannot resist. What is the best prediction?

text.en: Only the plants nearest the road will be harmed.

feedback.en: Nothing in the case protects the far plants. They share the same weakness.

text.en: The cuttings cannot catch it, as they carry no seed.

feedback.en: Plants catch diseases whether or not they carry seeds.

text.en: Each plant will resist it a little differently.

feedback.en: These plants are genetically identical, so they do not differ in resistance.

text.en: It can spread through all, since they are alike.

feedback.en: Yes. Genetically identical plants share the same weakness.

explanation.en: All thousand plants are genetically identical. If the variety cannot resist a disease, no plant in the field can, so the disease can spread through them all.

hints.en: How many different kinds of plant are in this field?
If one plant cannot resist the disease, can its identical neighbour?
